digest.component_or_area: project-wide development process and quality tracking
propositions: No current work tickets expose bug detected_by metadata with sufficient coverage (1.1%) to calculate true escape rates or detection-stage efficiency.
Plan-review first-pass rate is 49.0% with p90 attempts of 8, driven by semantic criteria; deterministic structural preflight checks could reduce LLM-call cost and churn before architectural review.

Completion first-pass rate of 72.3% is associated with Testing-section headings and file-impact declarations, but failure reasons (defect vs. environment vs. verifier error) are not machine-classified, blocking targeted intervention.

Governance adoption (ticket trailers, DCO, Change-Id) rose from 0% to ~100% during Q2–Q3; source diffs became smaller (median 111.5→95 lines) and test co-change increased (median 84.5→160.5 lines), consistent with process maturation.
35 modules at or above 720 LOC and 15 at or above 780 LOC signal debt pressure; same-file retouch within 24h occurs in 47.7% of consecutive pairs, indicating hotspot churn.

Caused_by links are advisory with demonstrable false-positive risk (blame over recorded impacts, single-point fan-in); claimed source tickets were larger (median 912 vs. 256 lines) and had lower initial plan-PASS (30.3% vs. 49.5%), but causality is confounded with size and blame-attribution bias.
